author: m. n. farris
title: Presbyterian College baseball falls to Florida Atlantic 12-2 in Boca Raton
text:
The Presbyterian College baseball team lost to Florida Atlantic University 12-2 on March 10 at FAU Baseball Stadium in Boca Raton, Florida. The defeat brings the Blue Hose’s record to 2-15 for the season.
Florida Atlantic took an early lead, scoring two runs in the first inning and adding three more in the second to go up 5-0. Presbyterian responded in the third inning with two runs of their own. Jonathan Williams singled home James Green for the team’s first run, followed by Emory Guilford doubling to score Amman Dewberry and narrow the deficit to three runs.
Despite this effort, Florida Atlantic regained momentum with a run in the fourth inning and another in the sixth, extending their advantage to 7-2. The Owls sealed their victory with five more runs on four hits in the eighth inning, ending the game after eight innings with a final score of 12-2.
James Green and Holden Baker each had multi-hit games for Presbyterian. Baker reached base three times, going 2-for-3 with a walk—his second career multi-hit game and his first since March 22, 2024 at Longwood. Green went 2-for-4 and has now recorded hits in eight of Presbyterian’s last ten games. Williams and Guilford were responsible for driving in Presbyterian’s two runs; Guilford now has thirteen RBIs this season.
Bauer Burkart started as pitcher for Presbyterian, while nine pitchers appeared throughout the night for the Blue Hose. Landon Nichols made his collegiate debut pitching during the eighth inning.
The Blue Hose are scheduled to conclude their two-game series against Florida Atlantic tomorrow at 4:00 p.m.
